entries.interpretation: All 19 nominal-protocol repeat fits are reported alongside the original grid. Fresh fitted-state CUDA replay is exact, but retraining is not identical to the original unsaved weights; the largest paired energy change is 0.011673. entries.manuscript_destination: P2 Abstract/Methods/Results/Discussion; Figure 9; Tables tab:p2followcoupling, tab:p2followrepresentation, tab:p2follownested, tab:p2followalpha, tab:p2followshrinkage, tab:p2followdecode
entries.interpretation: Computational follow-up using the same three donors and discovery-trained frozen encoder. Not biological replication, a new clock-fit study, full alpha-grid replay, retrospective proof of historical training inputs, convergence, CPU portability or unrestricted superiority. Alternate couplings and longer training did not beat translation in at least two of three day-7 donors. Nested selection reduced errors but still lost to the target marginal in two donors. Keep unequal search budgets, coordinate dependence, target-informed alpha oracle status, ratio-of-means versus mean-log estimands and empirical-decoder limitations.
